import java.io.*;
import java.math.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 998244353;
    static final BigInteger BIG_MOD = BigInteger.valueOf(MOD);

    static void printError() {
        System.out.println(-1);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner();
        PrintWriter out = new PrintWriter(System.out);

        int t = 1;

        while (t-- > 0) {
            long n = sc.nextLong(), m = sc.nextLong(), l = sc.nextLong(), r = sc.nextLong();
            long k = r - l;
            long even = k / 2 + 1;
            long odd = (k + 1) / 2;

            if ((n * m) % 2 == 1) {
                BigInteger base = BigInteger.valueOf(k + 1);
                BigInteger exp = BigInteger.valueOf(n * m);
                out.println(base.modPow(exp, BIG_MOD));
            } else {
                BigInteger base1 = BigInteger.valueOf(even + odd);
                BigInteger base2 = BigInteger.valueOf(even - odd);
                BigInteger exp = BigInteger.valueOf(n * m);

                BigInteger temp1 = base1.modPow(exp, BIG_MOD);
                BigInteger temp2 = base2.modPow(exp, BIG_MOD);

                long sum = Long.parseLong(temp1.toString()) + Long.parseLong(temp2.toString());
                long result = (sum * ((MOD + 1) / 2)) % MOD;
                out.println(result);
            }
        }
        out.flush();
    }

    static class Scanner {
        BufferedReader br;
        StringTokenizer st;

        Scanner() {
            br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        }

        String next() throws IOException {
            while (st == null || !st.hasMoreTokens())
                st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            return st.nextToken();

        long nextLong() throws IOException {
            return Long.parseLong(next());
        }
